tagline: Authenticator codes that live in this file. Works on a plane. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Accounts stay inside this file, on this device. Close it and come back — the same codes are still ticking. There is no account, no cloud, and an invite does not share a secret. Works on a plane.

Paste an otpauth:// link or a base32 secret. Codes refresh every 30 seconds. Tap a code to copy it. Import an Aegis JSON backup, export the same, or show a backup QR for one account. Handing someone a copy of this file hands them the codes — treat it like the authenticator itself.

Unofficial wrap of OTPAuth by Héctor Molinero Fernández. The library writes the codes; this is the authenticator around it.
